column1: # poly-suite archaic-introgression-informative SNP panel  (SEED / ILLUSTRATIVE)
# STATUS: SEED. This ships the SCHEMA + a construction recipe + a small set of
#   well-known Neanderthal-introgressed loci. It is deliberately below the
#   provisional threshold (bin/neanderthal.py MIN_PANEL_SITES=500), so any
#   percentage computed from it is flagged PROVISIONAL-SEED and must NOT be
#   interpreted. Replace with the full curated tag-SNP set (recipe below).
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; first non-comment line is the header):
#   chrom  pos  ref  archaic_allele  weight  rsid  locus
#     chrom/pos          GRCh38 coordinates (with or without 'chr' prefix)
#     ref                GRCh38 reference allele
#     archaic_allele     Neanderthal-derived allele (the one we count)
#     weight             per-allele contribution (1.0 = simple count); reserved
#     rsid, locus        provenance only (ignored by the loader)
# CONSTRUCTION RECIPE (to build the production panel, few-thousand tag SNPs):
#   1. Take the high-coverage archaic genomes: Vindija 33.19 + Altai Neanderthal
#      (Prufer et al. 2017, Max Planck public VCFs).
#   2. Select sites where the archaic-derived allele is (a) present in Neanderthal,
#      (b) near-absent in 1000G African samples (YRI/LWK AF < 0.01), and (c) present
#      in non-Africans — i.e. introgression tag SNPs (Sankararaman 2014 CRF map,
#      Vernot & Akey 2016 S*, Browning 2018 Sprime, or Chen 2020 IBDmix segments).
#   3. LD-prune to ~1 tag SNP per introgressed haplotype block.
#   4. Calibrate the archaic-allele fraction -> genome-wide % against 1000G
#      super-populations (EUR ~1.8-2.4%, EAS ~2.3-2.6%, AFR ~0.3%); write the
#      slope/intercept to resources/neanderthal_calibration.json.
# The rows below are ILLUSTRATIVE canonical introgression loci for wiring/testing.
# Verify every coordinate/allele against the recipe sources before production use.
